main.job: identity: who or what someone is, origin, traits
location and how someone is right now
that: joins a second sentence (creo que…, dice que…)
main.why: clause glue; lets the learner report and give opinions; different word from excluded qué (R-EX-04)
condition glue; different word from excluded sí (R-EX-04)

spares.why: next glue item; answer word, not the question por qué

shape.notes: The excluded qué starts the question-word set (quién, dónde, cuándo, cómo, cuánto, cuál, por qué = 7 more). Finishing it would take 7 of 10 slots and leave want/can/must/go/have uncovered, so it is left for the next run rather than started half-done; qué plus intonation covers the question job for now. Subject pronouns (9+ members) are also too big for this count; verb endings carry the person. si and que are included on purpose: the accent makes them different words from the excluded sí and qué.
